title: Sample week (format demo)
notes: A complete example of the week format. Not loaded by the app; tests import it to prove the format works end to end.

db-floor-press.u: Chest press lying on the floor, elbows stop at the floor.
s: Lie on your back, knees bent, dumbbells over your chest.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause, then press up, breathing out.
db-floor-press.m: Bouncing the elbows off the floor.
db-floor-press.z: Breathe out on the effort; never hold your breath.

run0104.name: Zone 2 Run 20
run0104.safe: Conversational pace, walk whenever needed. Steady pace, RPE 5–6.

blocks.name: Zone 2 run
blocks.small: 1:00 walk break whenever needed: tap +1 walk break.

up0105.name: Strength · Upper (sample)
up0105.safe: Breathe out on every rep, stop 2 reps short (2 RIR). RPE 6–7.

blocks.name: Row intervals 4 × 0:40 / 0:40
blocks.note: Each round: 0:40 work · 0:40 rest. Moderate pace, RPE 7.

kb0106.name: KB EMOM 9 (sample)
kb0106.safe: One 16 kg kettlebell. Breathe out on every swing and press. Smooth reps at RPE 6–7 (2 RIR).

blocks.name: Single-bell EMOM
blocks.note: Each 60 s: press left · press right · swings.

blocks.name: Floor core
blocks.note: Each round: 30 s per move · 30 s rest.

bk0105.name: Backup · Walk + Core (sample)
bk0105.safe: Lower energy day. Breathe out slowly on every effort. Easy pace, RPE 3–4.

blocks.name: Floor core
blocks.note: Each round: 30 s per move · 30 s rest.

ris.bk0105: Zone 2 run: conversational, a little breathless. Walk whenever you need to. Steady pace, RPE 5–6.
